correctness.rationale: Each substituted image has c ones. For n=bm+r and offset s, the boundary correction is c floor((s+r)/b) + P_end(t)-P_start(s), with m complete-block baseline. Primitive/positive substitution ensures uniform recurrence; if an aperiodic fixed point lacked one orientation of mismatch at distance d, monotone differences along arithmetic progression combined with bounded telescoping sum would contradict recurrence, giving both ordered pairs and attainment of extrema. Sliding windows change one-count by at most 1, hence no holes. Aperiodicity of 0^p1^q/1^q0^p checked via divisibility/period shrink argument. Independent enumeration across five explicit (p,q) examples and n=bm+r, m=1,2,4, agrees; m≥1 all residues proof is infinite.
